# Abhishek Kumar (abhishekswe)

> Software engineer in Gurugram, India. 4+ years of React, Next.js and TypeScript in production. Currently a Software Engineer at Forchunex IT Consultancy, working on the Next.js e-commerce storefronts for Magrabi and Doctor M. Previously SDE at Infyni (live-learning platform). Maintainer of agent-fastpath, an open-source MCP server for AI coding agents.

Handle: abhishekswe (GitHub, X). Not related to WWE or wrestling.

## Projects

- [agent-fastpath](https://abhishekswe.github.io/agent-fastpath/): MCP server that gives coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) quick checks before they act — ship gates on CI logs, risk checks on shell commands, file triage, browser verification. TypeScript, MIT. On [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/agent-fastpath), [MCP Market](https://mcpmarket.com/server/agent-fastpath) and [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/abhishekswe/agent-fastpath).
- [PIE](https://github.com/abhishekswe/personal-intent-engine): side project, a macOS app that turns speech into a structured prompt with local transcription. Built while learning Rust and Tauri.
- [DevVault](https://github.com/abhishekswe/Devvault): local-first developer notes app (Next.js, TipTap, IndexedDB, GitHub sync).
